name: D2IncidentAt
title: DHIS2 incident date
description: The moment the incident a DHIS2 tracker enrollment follows occurred - the occurredAt of the enrollment. A registration form states on D2CollectsIncidentDate whether its program collects one, and a response to a form declaring false carries none.
